label: Start with an empty workspace. Material has no instrument or lane.
A five-step note source. It can exist and play before any binding.
Audition the source through the temporary Init sound.
Return to the song; audition created no persistent instrument.
Harmony has its own 64-step clock.
Add the two sources. Five and sixty-four keep their independent periods.
Make a Rack Synth instance and an Audio channel, with a three-voice unison patch.
keys: :instrument Lead pulse_lead<Enter>:param vco_a.unison 3<Enter>:param vco_a.unison_detune 9ct<Enter>:param vco_a.unison_width 75%<Enter>:param vco_b.unison 3<Enter>:param vco_b.unison_detune 9ct<Enter>:param vco_b.unison_width 75%<Enter>:param cutoff 1750hz<Enter>:param resonance 14%<Enter>:param drive 14%<Enter>:param sub.level 16%<Enter>

label: Join material to sound. A lane schedules the part.
keys: :part LeadPart Moving Lead<Enter>:lane LeadLane<Enter>:place LeadPart LeadLane 1 4 song<Enter>

label: A second placement shares the same source, with its own ending.
Another part follows the same harmonic source, using an offbeat rhythm.
keys: :pattern rhythm Offbeats ..x...x...x...x.<Enter>:derive Low from Harmony Offbeats -14 85% 1.25<Enter>

label: The bass uses its own instrument and destination.
keys: :instrument Bass sub_bass<Enter>:param drive 24%<Enter>:part BassPart Low Bass<Enter>:lane BassLane<Enter>:place BassPart BassLane 1 8 song<Enter>

label: The part new shortcut creates a complete part in one undoable operation.
keys: :part new Pulse kick 0 . . .<Enter>:part new Spark closed_hat . . 0 .<Enter>

label: Group the pitched parts. Channel trim stays independent of modulation.
keys: :channel group Music<Enter>:route Lead Music<Enter>:route Bass Music<Enter>:channel Lead<Enter>:param trim 72%<Enter>:channel Bass<Enter>:param trim 92%<Enter>:channel Pulse<Enter>:param trim 100%<Enter>:channel Spark<Enter>:param trim 52%<Enter>:channel master<Enter>:param trim 88%<Enter>

label: A native Delay on a shared Return channel.
keys: :channel return Echo<Enter>:fx add delay Echo<Enter>:param time 3<Enter>:param feedback 38%<Enter>:send Lead Echo 28%<Enter>:channel Echo<Enter>:param trim 68%<Enter>

label: A second Return adds space through native Reverb.
keys: :channel return Space<Enter>:fx add reverb Space<Enter>:param size 68%<Enter>:param decay 2.5s<Enter>:param damping 5200hz<Enter>:send Lead Space 24%<Enter>:channel Space<Enter>:param trim 72%<Enter>

label: Kick onsets trigger a duck envelope on Music. This is a retained relationship.
An independent level shape multiplies the group trim.
keys: :pattern values Energy 128 ramp 0:0.72 32:0.9 64:1 112:0.8<Enter>:mod Contour channel Music gain Energy<Enter>

label: Seeded per-note pan variation belongs to the binding.
One harmony edit updates lead and bass; the placement ending remains local.
Fork keeps dependency links. Freeze deliberately captures a finite result.
Named sections are navigation and loop ranges.
The Mixer owns audio, effects, routing and meters.
